warning: This gate designs storage controls only. It does not write canonical source records, publish production data, create accounts, bypass reviewer approval, provide therapy, give ritual instruction, or become spiritual authority.
storage_policy: A storage design can be marked ready only from an approved release-review packet. It may define schema, audit receipt, rollback receipt, and replay rules, but canonical writes remain false.

storage_checks.rule: Input review must be approved for storage design.
Schema defines records without enabling writes.
Every future write must create an audit receipt.
Rollback must be recorded before production mutation is allowed.
Changes must be replayable from source packets and receipts.

sample_release_review.review_note: Dry-run evidence is clear enough to design storage controls without approving production writes.
sample_release_review.signoff_summary: Approve storage-design planning only; canonical source-answer data remains untouched.
sample_release_review.storage_boundary: Storage design only; no canonical writes, no production publish, and no final release.
sample_release_review.rollback_confirmed: Confirmed: rollback is deletion of the dry-run packet and no source-answer data changed.
sample_release_review.canonical_diff_confirmed: Confirmed: no canonical source diff and source-answer dataset unchanged.
warnings: Storage design only; not production write approval.

A release reviewer may approve the next storage-design step only after a dry-run audit is ready for release review. Production readiness and canonical writes remain false until storage controls, immutable audit, rollback receipts, and final founder instruction exist.

dry_run_audit.audit_note: Dry run is ready for release review because source writes remain blocked and rollback is clear.
dry_run_audit.dry_run_result: No production write executed; task packet can be discarded cleanly.
dry_run_audit.rollback_evidence: Rollback is deletion of the dry-run packet; canonical source-answer data remains unchanged.
dry_run_audit.canonical_diff_evidence: No canonical source diff; source-answer dataset unchanged.
warnings: Release review can approve storage design only, not production writes.
A queued implementation task may enter release review only after dry-run evidence proves canonical writes stayed blocked, rollback is clear, and the source-answer dataset remains unchanged.

implementation_task.task_note: Prepare a dry-run task for the approved boundary/readiness fields only.
implementation_task.implementation_plan: Create a non-canonical patch packet for review_state, readiness, and boundary copy only.
implementation_task.test_plan: Check that source, citation, and canonical text fields remain unchanged; verify generated packet can be discarded cleanly.
implementation_task.rollback_plan: Rollback by deleting the implementation task and keeping source-answer records unchanged.
warnings: Dry-run task only; not a release.

owner_packet.owner_note: Approve only the editable boundary and readiness path. Canonical citation fields remain unchanged.
owner_packet.approval_scope: Approve review_state, readiness, and boundary language only.
owner_packet.blocked_field_disposition: Exclude the source field from scope; do not edit canonical citation or rights-sensitive text.
owner_packet.rollback_instruction: Rollback by discarding this owner approval packet and keeping the existing source-answer record unchanged.
owner_packet.implementation_guard: Implementation queue may draft a non-canonical change packet only; production storage and immutable audit remain required.
warnings: Blocked fields remain outside owner approval scope.
A source owner may approve a reviewed proposal for implementation queue only when the scope excludes blocked fields, rollback is explicit, and production storage remains separate.

review_packet.review_note: Diff is clear enough for source-owner review, but blocked source field must remain out of scope.
review_packet.rollback_note: Rollback by discarding this proposal packet; canonical source record remains unchanged in preview.
warnings: Proposal contains blocked fields; keep them out of owner approval scope.

A source proposal can move through local review states, but production still requires source-owner approval, durable identity, immutable audit, rollback readiness, and controlled storage before canonical records change.

audit_packet.decision_note: Accept as a proposal for source-record update review, not as a canonical change.
audit_packet.evidence_note: Bhagavad Gita 2.48 record supports calm reflection with a boundary against therapy or guaranteed outcomes.
audit_packet.boundary_note: Keep the result as source-backed reflection support only.
warnings: Accepted local decision remains proposal-only until production storage and identity exist.

diffs.current_value: Reflection support only; not therapy, medical advice, or command language.
diffs.proposed_value: Reflection support only; not therapy, medical advice, ritual instruction, or spiritual authority.

blocked_fields.reason: Canonical or rights-sensitive field requires a separate source-owner process.

warnings: Accepted or recommended review packets may create source-update proposals. Production must require durable identity, immutable audit, diff review, source-owner approval, and rollback before any canonical record changes.

sample_design.design_note: Design storage controls without enabling canonical writes.
sample_design.schema_summary: Tables: source_answer_drafts, review_receipts, audit_receipts, rollback_receipts, replay_queue.
sample_design.audit_receipt_rule: Every accepted future write must create an immutable audit receipt with actor, packet id, source_answer_id, before hash, after hash, and reason.
sample_design.rollback_receipt_rule: Every write must include a rollback receipt plan with before state, restore action, and discard path before it can be promoted.
sample_design.replay_rule: Storage changes must be replayable from release-review packets, source packet snapshots, and audit receipts.
sample_design.write_boundary: Design only; canonical_write_allowed remains false and no production source data is written.
